extension.description: Reviews kim commands that mutate the local reminder config, daemon state, or notification settings; read-only inspection stays automatic.
extension.name: kim reminder protection

permissions.description: Identifies `kim add`, which writes a new recurring or one-shot reminder into the local kim config. Reviewing creation prevents an assistant from silently installing scheduled notifications or their recurring side effects.
permissions.label: kim reminder creation
safer_guidance: List existing reminders with kim list before creating new ones.
Confirm the exact title, message, and schedule with the user.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim disable`, which deactivates a reminder in the local kim config. Reviewing the disable prevents an assistant from silently silencing user-scheduled notifications.
permissions.label: kim reminder disable
safer_guidance: List reminders with kim list and confirm the exact name before disabling it.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim edit`, which opens the local kim config in the user's $EDITOR. Reviewing the edit prevents an assistant from launching an editor on kim's configuration without user awareness.
permissions.label: kim config edit
safer_guidance: Show the current kim config with kim list or kim status before editing it.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim enable`, which activates a disabled reminder in the local kim config. Reviewing the enable prevents an assistant from silently re-activating scheduled notifications.
permissions.label: kim reminder enable
safer_guidance: List reminders with kim list and confirm the exact name before enabling it.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim export`, which writes the local kim reminders to an output file. Reviewing the export prevents an assistant from silently writing reminder contents to an arbitrary path.
permissions.label: kim reminder export
safer_guidance: Confirm the output path with the user before exporting reminders to a file.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim import`, which loads reminders from a file and can wholesale replace the local kim config. Reviewing the import prevents an assistant from injecting many notifications or overwriting the user's existing schedule.
permissions.label: kim reminder import
safer_guidance: Show the import file contents to the user and confirm the destination config before importing.
Prefer kim import --merge to avoid overwriting existing reminders.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim interactive`, which enters an interactive session that can run arbitrary kim mutations. Reviewing interactive mode prevents an assistant from dropping into a direct mutating session without user awareness.
permissions.label: kim interactive mode
safer_guidance: Use individual kim subcommands so each mutation can be reviewed on its own.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim remind`, which schedules a one-shot reminder that fires a persistent notification after a delay. Reviewing the one-shot prevents an assistant from silently scheduling a surprise notification.
permissions.label: kim one-shot reminder
safer_guidance: Confirm the exact message and fire time with the user before scheduling.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim remove`, which permanently deletes a reminder from the local kim config. Reviewing removal prevents an assistant from discarding user-scheduled notifications.
permissions.label: kim reminder removal
safer_guidance: List existing reminders with kim list and confirm the exact name before removing it.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim self-update`, which pulls and installs a new kim version over the network. Reviewing self-updates prevents an assistant from installing new executable code into the user's Python environment.
permissions.label: kim self-update
safer_guidance: Confirm with the user before updating kim or any Python-installed tooling.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim slack`, which inspects or test-sends Slack notification configuration. Reviewing slack commands prevents an assistant from silently sending test notifications through the user's Slack integration.
permissions.label: kim slack configuration
safer_guidance: Show the current Slack configuration with kim slack before sending test notifications.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim sound`, which changes the local kim notification sound settings. Reviewing sound mutations prevents an assistant from silently adjusting or disabling user notification sound.
permissions.label: kim sound configuration
safer_guidance: Show the current sound configuration with kim sound before changing it.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim start`, which spawns the kim reminder daemon as a detached background process. Reviewing the start prevents an assistant from silently launching a persistent notification process.
permissions.label: kim daemon start
safer_guidance: Check kim status to confirm whether the daemon is running and why a start is needed.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim stop`, which stops the kim reminder daemon and suspends all future notifications. Reviewing the stop prevents an assistant from disabling scheduled reminders without user awareness.
permissions.label: kim daemon stop
safer_guidance: Check kim status to confirm whether the daemon is running and why a stop is needed.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim uninstall`, which removes kim and its scheduled reminders from the system. Reviewing uninstall prevents an assistant from permanently removing user-scheduled notifications.
permissions.label: kim uninstall
safer_guidance: Confirm with the user before uninstalling kim; export reminders first if they want a backup.

permissions.description: Identifies `kim update`, which rewrites an existing reminder's schedule, title, message, or enabled state in the local kim config. Reviewing updates prevents silent changes to user-scheduled notifications.
permissions.label: kim reminder update
safer_guidance: Show the current reminder details first, then confirm the exact change with the user.
